newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Ireland's NTMA sells 212.5 mln punts of 5-yr bond.
newsitem.headline: Ireland's NTMA sells 212.5 mln punts of 5-yr bond.

text.p: Ireland's National Treasury Management Agency (NTMA) said on Tuesday that it sold a total of 212.5 million punts of the 6.5 percent bond due 2001.
The NTMA, which announced a 100 million punt tap in the five-year bond, said demand was so strong for the issue that it exercised a provision to sell additional stock.
"The demand was so strong we decided to sell more and issued a total of 212.5 million punts which still did not supply up to the full extent of the demand," a spokesman for the NTMA said.
Market sources said demand was sparked by EMU covergence demand.
